docs.body:
What is the upload limit?

OP: Mine seems to be around 100 MB. Is that the default?

Reply 1: Same here, roughly that. I never found a setting for it.

Reply 2: I mailed support twice and got nothing. 100 MB is my guess too, only a guess.

Reply 3: Check the configuration reference before you trust any of us. Nobody here has.
docs.snippet: Mine looks like about 100 MB. Is that the default? Nobody in the thread got a straight answer.
docs.title: What is the upload limit? - Meridian forum

docs.body:
Meridian configuration reference.

The default upload limit is 600 MB when the setting is not configured.

Raising it is the usual fix when the default feels too small; the reference is the only authoritative source.
